notes:
• The Union Budget of India is traditionally presented on February 1.
  • World Wetlands Day is observed globally on February 2.
  • World Cancer Day is marked on February 4 to raise awareness.
  • National Science Day is celebrated on February 28 to mark the discovery of the Raman Effect.
  • Surajkund International Crafts Mela is held in February in Haryana.
  • Kala Ghoda Arts Festival takes place in Mumbai every February.
  • Safer Internet Day is observed on the second day of the second week of February.
  • World Radio Day is celebrated on February 13.
  • International Mother Language Day is observed on February 21.
  • Central Excise Day in India is observed on February 24.
  • World NGO Day is recognized on February 27.
  • Taj Mahotsav is an annual 10-day festival held in Agra in February.
  • National Women's Day of India is celebrated on February 13, marking Sarojini Naidu's birth anniversary.
  • Arunachal Pradesh and Mizoram celebrate their Statehood Day on February 20.
  • World Pulses Day is recognized by the UN on February 10.
  • International Day of Women and Girls in Science is on February 11.
  • Darwin Day, celebrating Charles Darwin's birth, is on February 12.
  • World Day of Social Justice is observed on February 20.
  • World Thinking Day is celebrated by Scout and Guide organizations on February 22.
  • Rare Disease Day is observed on the last day of February.
